title: Tax Graph Edge
description: A typed, directed relationship between two nodes. Edges reference rules by id; they never contain executable code.

rule_id.description: The rule applied along this edge (expected for computational relationships).

role.description: Operand position for order-sensitive rules, e.g. 'minuend'/'subtrahend' for SUBTRACT, 'numerator'/'denominator' for DIVIDE, 'addend' for SUM. Omit for single-input rules like COPY. A computed node's value is produced by all edges that target it sharing a rule_id.

condition.description: Optional gate: which fact/decision and value activates this edge.
